items.title: Kalshi sues Illinois over Senate Bill 3019, seeking to block the sports contract law before its July 1 start
items.content_text: - **Kalshi sues Illinois over Senate Bill 3019, seeking to block the sports contract law before its July 1 start** — Kalshi filed suit in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois against Governor JB Pritzker, Attorney General Kwame Raoul and gaming board officials, arguing Senate Bill 3019 expressly bans its sports event contracts unless it enters a state licensing regime. Kalshi says the law conflicts with CFTC authority, and that compliance costs and enforcement risk would cause irreparable harm when the statute takes effect on July 1. items.content_text: - **CFTC files Sixth Circuit amicus backing Kalshi in Ohio sports contracts dispute** — The CFTC filed an amicus brief in the Sixth Circuit backing Kalshi in its appeal after Ohio told the platform last year to halt sports event contracts as unlicensed gambling and a district court denied an injunction in March. In August trading volume the order reversed, with Kalshi at 37.17 billion dollars compared with 8.16 billion dollars across Polymarket and Polymarket US. ([Gambling Insider](https://www.gamblinginsider.com/news/196243/polymarket-kalshi-us-prediction-market-search-demand))

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket midterm election betting passes 220 million dollars, more than double 2024 cycle
items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket midterm election betting passes 220 million dollars, more than double 2024 cycle** — Bonus, citing Reuters and analysis by the Anti-Corruption Data Collective, reports more than 220 million dollars has been wagered on 2026 midterm elections across Kalshi and Polymarket, more than double the 92 million dollars in the 2024 congressional cycle. The analysis covered more than 21,000 congressional markets and found the top 1 percent of wallets accounted for 70 percent of Polymarket congressional volume. ([Bonus](https://www.bonus.com/news/election-betting-tops-220m-on-kalshi-and-polymarket-ahead-of-2026-midterms/))

items.title: Polymarket and Kalshi prices differ by just 0.9 points on average across 202 matched outcomes
items.content_text: - **Polymarket and Kalshi prices differ by just 0.9 points on average across 202 matched outcomes** — Zona de Azar reports an analysis updated October 13 examined 202 outcomes available on both Polymarket and Kalshi and found an average price difference of just 0.9 percentage points, with 95 percent of outcomes within 2 points. Gaps were widest in economy and business at 2.3 points and narrowest in sports at 0.7 points. ([Zona de Azar](https://zonadeazar.com/juego-online/polymarket-and-kalshi-show-minimal-gaps-across-prediction-markets/))

items.title: Polymarket and Kalshi price Fed October decision 4 points apart on no-change outcome
items.content_text: - **Polymarket and Kalshi price Fed October decision 4 points apart on no-change outcome** — A market comparison notes Polymarket priced no change for the Fed October decision at 75 to 76 cents while Kalshi priced Fed maintains rate at 71 to 72 cents, a gap of about 4 points. Polymarket's October event had traded about 40.5 million dollars and Kalshi's about 11.1 million contracts.
